# Identical cells under noise

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`identical-cells-under-noise` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](identical-cells-under-noise.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Under the core's descent with an exchangeable field and noise of one law at every cell, over finite states, an exchangeable start stays exchangeable at every step: every cell has the law of every other, and where noise and start are laws each assignment of distinct states has weight at most 1/m!.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Over finitely many cells and states, weights on configurations move in discrete steps by kernels, one per step. A kernel commuting with a rearrangement of the cells keeps weights it leaves unchanged unchanged, so under kernels commuting with every rearrangement an exchangeable start stays exchangeable at every step; nonnegative kernels with rows of total one keep a law a law (weightsAt_exchangeable and eleven more). (`Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.rearrange`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.Invariant`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.Exchangeable`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.KernelCommutes`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.step`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.weightsAt`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.step_invariant`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.weightsAt_invariant`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.weightsAt_exchangeable`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.step_nonneg`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.step_total`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.weightsAt_law`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.
2. Identical cells at the start: the law of all cells in one state, and the law of the cells independent, each of one law, are exchangeable laws; the law of one configuration is unchanged by a rearrangement exactly where the configuration is, so it is exchangeable only with all its cells alike (pointMass_exchangeable_alike and seven more). (`Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.pointMass`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.pointMass_invariant_iff`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.pointMass_exchangeable_alike`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.alike_fixed`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.alike_exchangeable`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.independent_exchangeable`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.independent_law`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.pointMass_law`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.
3. What an exchangeable law leaves undecided: every cell has the law of every other, and where the law is nonnegative with total one, each assignment of distinct states to the cells has weight at most one over the number of orderings of the cells (marginal_eq, distinct_le). (`Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.marginal`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.marginal_eq`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.distinct_le`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.
4. Stationary laws come in rearranged sets under a kernel commuting with every rearrangement, so a unique stationary law is exchangeable; the Gibbs weights exp(-κF) normalized, for any real κ, of a free energy no rearrangement changes are exchangeable, no kernel being shown to keep them (unique_stationary_exchangeable and three more). (`Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.Stationary`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.stationary_rearranged`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.unique_stationary_exchangeable`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.gibbs_exchangeable`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.
5. A rule with noise of one law at every cell, each cell going independently from the state the rule gives it: where the rule commutes with a rearrangement so does the rule with noise; with no noise the law of one configuration follows the rule's run (noisy_commutes, weightsAt_noiseless and three more). (`Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.noisy`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.noisy_commutes`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.noiseless`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.step_noiseless`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.weightsAt_noiseless`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.
6. The join to the core: the core's descent, read cell by cell on a configuration read as a list, has the core's run as its run, so with no noise the law weighs one exactly the configuration the core's run reaches; two cells alike at the start stay alike whatever the field (noiseless_run, cellwise_alike and three more). (`Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.cellwise`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.ofFn_cellwise`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.ofFn_iterate_cellwise`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.cellwise_alike`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.noiseless_run`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.
7. Exchanging neighbouring cells is rearranging by a transposition, and these generate every rearrangement; so with an exchangeable field the core's descent commutes with every rearrangement and its run from a rearranged start is the rearranged run, and a free energy symmetric in the core's sense and its Gibbs weights are unchanged by every rearrangement (ofFn_rearranged, run_rearranged and four more). (`Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.ofFn_swap`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.ofFn_rearranged`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.cellwise_commutes`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.run_rearranged`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.symmetric_rearranged`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.gibbs_symmetric_exchangeable`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.
8. The core's descent with noise of one law at every cell, each cell going independently from its own state and the field it senses, commutes with every rearrangement where the field is exchangeable: from an exchangeable start the weights are exchangeable at every step, and where noise and start are laws each assignment of distinct states to the m cells has weight at most 1/m! (noisyDescent_distinct_le and eight more). (`Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.noisyDescent`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.noisy_eq_noisyDescent`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.noisyDescent_commutes`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.noisyDescent_nonneg`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.noisyDescent_rows`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.noisyDescent_exchangeable`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.noisyDescent_distinct_le`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.noisyDescent_from_alike`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.noisyDescent_from_independent`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.
9. In finitely many states independent noise can part identical cells but never with certainty: from all cells in one state, under the descent with noise that is a law, some configuration of all cells alike has positive weight at every step; with a fair coin of its own for each of two cells, they part after one step with weight one quarter (alike_positive, Witness.independentNoise_parts). (`Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.alike_positive`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.Witness.independentNoise_parts`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.
10. A kernel taking every configuration of two cells to either parted one at one half commutes with the exchange and parts alike cells with certainty; it is the fair mixture of two rules assigning the places by the cells' numbers, neither commuting with the exchange, and no noise of one law at every cell; its only stationary law is that half and half (Witness.toParted_eq_mixture and seventeen more). (`Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.Witness.Two`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.Witness.sum_two`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.Witness.partedUniform`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.Witness.partedUniform_law`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.Witness.partedUniform_not_product`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.Witness.parted_rearranged`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.Witness.toParted`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.Witness.toParted_commutes`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.Witness.toParted_not_noisy`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.Witness.toParted_not_noisyDescent`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.Witness.toParted_once`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.Witness.alike_none`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.Witness.each_half`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.Witness.toParted_stationary_iff`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.Witness.partedUniform_exchangeable`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.Witness.assign`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.Witness.assign_not_commutes`, `Becoming.CellsUnderNoise.Witness.toParted_eq_mixture`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.
11. A field reading the state of the first cell reads no cell's number, yet reads the places through the list's order and is not exchangeable; with each cell flipping by it and no noise, from the parted half and half it gives cell 0 off and cell 1 on weight one and the two cells different laws (Witness.firstCell_assigns and three more). <a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- In the periphery, on Mathlib's reals: each declaration depends on Lean's three standard axioms at most, reported by the module's checker; the core laws it reads have empty axiom reports, and cellwise, ofFn_cellwise, ofFn_iterate_cellwise and cellwise_alike use no Classical.choice.
- Modelling choices: finitely many cells and states; real weights on configurations; a kernel a function of two configurations, with no measurability; discrete synchronous steps, the kernel allowed to change from step to step; the noise independent across cells and of one law, reading a cell's own state and the field it senses; the rearrangements all permutations of the cells.
- Exchangeability at every step needs a field exchangeable in the core's sense and an exchangeable start; the bound 1/m! needs in addition noise that is nonnegative with weights from each state and field totalling one, and a start that is a law.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Densities, continuous states or time, or Langevin flows: with a density exact alikeness has probability zero after one step, while here alike configurations keep weight.
- Whether a realization parts, or which place a given cell reaches.
- Which asymmetry actually differentiates cells.
- That a given kernel has a stationary law, a unique one, or one approached at any rate, or that any kernel keeps the Gibbs weights.
- That the 2015 paper's simulation fails: its scheme has the law's form, and no theorem here models it.
- Which configuration, differentiated or not, is better.
- **Counterexample:** A field reading the state of the first cell reads no cell's number, yet, not being exchangeable, from the parted half and half, an exchangeable start, with no noise it gives one assignment weight one and the two cells different laws (Witness.firstCell_assigns). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/free-energy/CellsUnderNoise.lean)
- **Counterexample:** A kernel commuting with exchanging two cells parts two alike cells with certainty: it is the fair mixture of two rules assigning the places by the cells' numbers, and no noise of one law at every cell (Witness.alike_none, Witness.toParted_eq_mixture, Witness.toParted_not_noisyDescent). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/free-energy/CellsUnderNoise.lean)

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Curie's principle (Curie 1894; Chalmers 1970, British Journal for the Philosophy of Science 21) in its form for indeterministic laws, a symmetric cause giving a symmetric distribution of effects (Ismael 1997, Synthese 110; Castellani and Ismael 2016, Philosophy of Science 83); spontaneous symmetry breaking, a symmetry the law keeps broken only in realizations (Earman 2004); no deterministic rule treating anonymous processors alike singles one out (Angluin 1980), while independent coins, one for each, break the symmetry with probability one, never with certainty within bounded steps (Itai and Rodeh 1990). Against Friston, Levin, Sengupta and Pezzulo (2015): their scheme, initial expectations independent and of one law, a signal symmetric in the cells and small independent noise, has the law's form, and the paper never claims which cell takes which place, so the law forbids nothing of it. Exchangeable laws staying exchangeable is classical; new are the join to the core's descent, its field, update and run, and the reading. Graded in UE24's NOTE.

### Dependencies

- **formal-reuse**: [identical-cells-under-a-descent-treating-them-alike](identical-cells-under-a-descent-treating-them-alike.md). exchangeAt, descent, Exchangeable, Symmetric and Law.run: the core's descent on identical cells, its exchange of neighbouring cells and its run, read with noise over the reals.
- related, not a proved adapter: [selection-through-a-model-of-the-options](selection-through-a-model-of-the-options.md). Selection through a model of the options: a choice reading the options only through a full tie singles out none; independent noise at each cell parts identical cells with positive weight, never with certainty (alike_positive, Witness.independentNoise_parts).
